prompts.star:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production character avatar for the native desktop agent app Labora.
Create ONE charming, tactile, little 3D five-pointed STAR character, golden butter-yellow. The star IS the entire character, with thick pillowy rounded points and a plump beveled extrusion, no human body or appendages. Face: two generously sized shiny dark espresso oval eyes with tiny white catchlights, subtly asymmetric curious expression, and a tiny relaxed smile. Warm personality, sophisticated collectible vinyl / glazed soft ceramic toy, not a flat vector emoji. Turn just 12 degrees to reveal thickness, eyes facing the viewer, subtle tilted pose. Saturated yellow, soft broad studio lighting from upper left, soft highlights and realistic self-shadow, beautiful rounded edges. Keep the silhouette and eyes legible at 32 pixels. Fully visible, centered, occupying 85 percent of the square frame. Genuine transparent alpha background, no floor plane, no cast shadow outside the character, no background color, no text, no watermark, no sparkle particles, no accessories, no separate objects.
prompts.cube:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new production character avatar for Labora, in the exact 3D toy family of the supplied reference star.
